# Open Source Initiative

> > The Open Source Initiative provides definitions, principles, and standards for open source software and AI, promoting freedom, transparency, and collaborative development.

The Open Source Initiative (OSI) is the leading organization defining and advocating for open source principles globally. This resource covers the emerging Open Source AI Definition 1.0 and related governance frameworks for transparent, safe, and freedom-respecting artificial intelligence.

## Key Topics

- Open Source Initiative
- Open Source AI Definition 1.0
- Open Source Principles
- AI Freedom
- Transparency
- AI Safety
- Openwashing
- AI Regulation
- Open Future
- Open Source Community

## Open Source AI Standards

- [Open Source AI](https://opensource.org/ai): Defines open source AI principles, freedom, transparency, and safety standards.
